requirements.title: Modules contain or access definitions made accessible to other program units
requirements.definition: A module contains or accesses definitions, including data objects, types, procedures, and interface blocks, that can be made accessible to other program units.

pending.module-data-object-definition-access: Module m exports integer parameter k=74; main USEs m and checks k==74.
pending.module-type-definition-access: Module m defines type t with integer component v; main USEs m, constructs t(75), and checks v==75.
pending.module-procedure-definition-access: Module m contains function f() returning 76; main USEs m and checks f()==76.
pending.module-interface-block-access: Module m exposes an explicit interface to an external function g returning 77; main USEs m and checks g()==77 under interface_block_15_4_3_2.json ownership.
